_file: The default benchmark: every attack in the default set once, at its plugin default. Write it with: deepmark-benchmark --init default > my_default.json, set general.wav_files_dir, general.report_dir and models, then run: deepmark-benchmark --config my_default.json. Keys starting with _ are comments. Check without running: add --validate-only. Every setting, commented: --init benchmark.
_general: Paths and run options. report_dir is EMPTIED at the start of every run, so give each run its own. seed: an integer makes watermarks and attack noise repeatable; null draws fresh ones.
_models: One model, or several for a comparative report. A Docker model's service must be running.
_attacks: The default attack set. NoAttack is the baseline. The Docker attacks in it (DescriptAudioCodec, Diffusion, Encodec, NetworkTransmission, NeuralVocoder, SpeechEnhancement1, SpeechTokenization, VAE) need their services running.
_attack_parameters: Empty: every attack runs at its plugin default. AttackName:version adds a strength, run and reported next to the default (see --init default_sweep).
_calculate_quality_metrics: false: accuracy (with BER and EMR) plus PESQ, ViSQOL and STOI. true: every metric each attack group enables (slower).
